english_text: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;"
english:
Life often brings correction that may feel uncomfortable.
Do not dismiss these moments, for they help you grow.
When faced with criticism, stay resilient and keep learning.
spanish:
La vida a menudo trae correcciones que pueden resultar incómodas.
No descartes esos momentos, pues te ayudan a crecer.
Al enfrentar críticas, mantente resiliente y sigue aprendiendo.
portuguese:
A vida frequentemente traz correções que podem ser desconfortáveis.
Não despreze esses momentos, pois eles ajudam você a crescer.
Ao enfrentar críticas, mantenha a resiliência e continue aprendendo.
french:
La vie apporte souvent des corrections qui peuvent être inconfortables.
Ne négligez pas ces moments, car ils vous aident à grandir.
Face aux critiques, restez résilient et continuez d’apprendre.
tagalog:
Minsan ang buhay ay nagdadala ng mga pagsasaayos na maaaring hindi komportable.
Huwag balewalain ang mga sandaling ito, dahil tumutulong ito sa iyong paglago.
Kapag humaharap sa kritisismo, manatiling matatag at patuloy na matuto.
swahili:
Maisha mara nyingi huleta marekebisho ambayo yanaweza kuwa yasiyofurahisha.
Usiyepuke nyakati hizi, kwani yanakusaidia kukua.
Unapokumbana na ukosoaji, kuwa imara na uendelee kujifunza.
mandarin_chinese:
生活常常带来让人不舒服的纠正。
不要忽视这些时刻，因为它们帮助你成长。
面对批评时，保持韧性并继续学习。
russian:
Жизнь часто приносит исправления, которые могут быть неприятными.
Не отвергайте эти моменты, ведь они помогают вам расти.
Столкнувшись с критикой, оставайтесь стойкими и продолжайте учиться.
malayalam:
ജീവിതം പലപ്പോഴും അസ്വസ്ഥതയുള്ള തിരുത്തലുകൾ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു.
ഈ നിമിഷങ്ങളെ അവഗണിക്കരുത്, കാരണം അവ നിങ്ങളെ വളരാൻ സഹായിക്കുന്നു.
വിമർശനത്തെ നേരിടുമ്പോൾ, ദൃഢതയോടെ തുടരുകയും പഠനം തുടരുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
